title: Can paste any type exported value into exported typed dictionary.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproduceable in: v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7260) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12600KF (16 threads)

### Issue description

When adding a new value into an exported typed dictionary from the inspector, the user can copy the value from an exported variable, and paste the value into the value field and add it to the typed dictionary without any expected error or issue.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Once the project is opened, selected the root node and navigate to the inspector. The included typed_dictionary_container.gd script should be attached. If not, then attach it to root.
2. Right click on the first exported variable "Copy Me" and select "Copy Value"
3. Next, under the typed dictionary, which should be of type [int, bool], right click "New Value" text beside the bool value, and select "Paste Value". You should find that the bool value has now been replaced with the string value instead.
4. You can then push the "Add Key/Value Pair" button and see it works without error. Note how the value field remains a string input until you refresh the inspector.
5. You can further test with the "Copy Me Too" value as well.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[typed-dictionary-bug-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19174850/typed-dictionary-bug-mrp.zip)
